full_judgment:
Latifur Rahman CJ: this petition by the defendant tenant-petitioners is against the judgment and order dated 11-5-2000 passed by a learned Single Judge Of the High Court Division in Civil Revision No. 52 of 2000 affirming the judgment and order dated 26-9-1999 passed by the Senior Assistant Judge, Sadar Pabna in Miscellaneous Case No, 61 of 1998 arising out of an application under Order 9 rule 13 of the Code of Civil Procedure for restoration of Small Causes Court Suit for eviction of the tenant. 

 2. It appears from the judgment of the learned Single Judge of the High Court Division that the Misc case was filed long after 5 years of the passing of the decree in Small Causes Court Suit No. 4 of 1987. The learned Single Judge further found that the Misc Case was filed just to delay the disposal of the execution proceeding and to continue in unauthorised possession of the suit premises.
